title: New Zealand's Himalayan tahr grew from five survivors to tens of thousands

Control measures, including government-led aerial shooting, have not proven entirely effective, creating a challenging situation for conservationists and hunters alike. The management of tahr remains an ongoing struggle within New Zealand's wildlife strategy.

However, Strickland later expressed sympathy and defended Poirier's sponsorship situation.
